title: AgentRail recette -- test agent manifest
description: What a test agent DECLARES about itself: identity and capability scope. Discovery and identification are validated against the ground-truth, not this manifest -- a deliberately-incorrect agent declares one thing here and does another at runtime.

agent_id.description: Stable unique id (slug). Used to bind ground-truth and discovery results.

principal.description: Declared principal (bot username, app slug, service account).

key_ref.description: Env var name holding the credential (NEVER the secret itself, see no-hardcoded-secrets).

capability_scope.description: Declared allowed actions. Identification checks observed actions stay within this set.

resources.description: Repo globs the action is allowed on, e.g. 'acme/*' or 'group/project'.

language.description: Implementation language (informational; discovery observes behavior, not source).

entrypoint.description: Relative path to the agent runnable, when present.

lab_mode.description: Runs against the simulated GitHub/GitLab lab.

real_mode.description: Runs against real test orgs/repos with real tokens.
